misprints.note: A full stop instead of the usual comma after the headword.
There is a full stop where a comma is expected before the article.

uncertain.note: The accent marks on τεϊ are hard to read: the acute could be on ε with a diaeresis on ι, or the form could be τεΐ. I kept τέϊ.
The mark over the ι of οἰσυπίς could be a circumflex plus breathing. I kept the smooth breathing. The genitive ending clearly has an acute and no breathing.
The mark after χρῖσμα could be a full stop or a faint comma. I kept the full stop.
In the letterspaced headword no space is visible before the parenthesis, so I left it out.
